subject: Alternate COI evidence and subcontractor coverage for PO activation
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.io>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bluewave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.io>
Date: 2027-04-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding - insurance evidence and conditional PO

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the productive kickoff today. To move BlueWave to PO activation we need a few items from your insurance broker per our procurement checklist. We can provision a conditional PO while outstanding items are being finalized, but the PO will not be released for billing until evidence is received. Please provide the following: 

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing policy limits and policy number (preferably PDF).
- Signed broker attestation if the insurer cannot issue an endorsement quickly (see guidance below).
- A current list of subcontractors who will have access to Redwood data or infrastructure (CSV or spreadsheet).
- Confirmation whether subcontractors will be listed as Additional Insured or whether primary/waiver language will be used.

If your insurer can issue an endorsement, the following language is preferred: 

"Redwood Inference, its subsidiaries and affiliates, and their respective officers, directors, employees and agents are named as Additional Insured with respect to commercial general liability and automobile liability, and waive subrogation as to workers' compensation where applicable."

If endorsement issuance will be delayed, we can accept a broker-signed attestation that includes the policy number, effective dates, and a commitment that the required endorsement will be issued within 30 days. The attestation must be on broker letterhead and include a broker contact.

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Conditional_0429.pdf (conditional PO template), Redwood_Attestation_Guidance.pdf (sample wording).

Please reply with the COI and either the endorsement or broker attestation, plus the subcontractor list. Let us know any constraints from your underwriter.

Thanks,
Irene
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bluewave.io>

Hi Irene,

Appreciate the checklist — attaching what we have from our broker.

Attached: BlueWave_Certificate_0427.pdf (COI), Broker_Attestation_0428.pdf (broker-signed attestation).

A couple of notes from our side: 
- Our primary insurer can provide the COI immediately but will not issue endorsements to name additional insureds for subcontractors without a separate request.
- The broker attestation confirms policy number AX-998271 and the limits listed. They have committed to requesting the endorsement, but timeline is a function of underwriter backlog (they estimate ~3–4 weeks).
- We will need clarity from Redwood on whether a waiver of subrogation is mandatory or an endorsement can be provided after PO activation (we generally add that to the request, subject to underwriter approval).

We can also send a CSV with the subcontractor roster — attaching a placeholder list now and will update with the live roster once procurement confirms what level of listing (AI vs primary) Redwood requires.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Legal Ops, BlueWave Analytics
Attachments: BlueWave_Certificate_0427.pdf, Broker_Attestation_0428.pdf

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - insurance evidence and conditional PO

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the attestation. A few clarifications and next steps: 

- The waiver of subrogation is not strictly mandatory for every cover type, but we do require either (a) waiver language on the policy or (b) confirmation that Redwood will be named as Additional Insured on CGL and Auto where activities are performed. Workers' comp waiver is nice-to-have where permitted by jurisdiction.

- We can proceed with a conditional PO (see attached Redwood_PO_Conditional_0429.pdf) while the formal endorsement is pending if the broker attestation includes: policy number, insurer contact, and a commitment to issue the endorsement within 30 days. Your Broker_Attestation_0428.pdf looks close to acceptable; please ensure it includes a broker phone/email and the policy number in the attestation body (not just the COI image).

- For subcontractors: please provide the full legal names, the scope of work, and whether they will perform work on Redwood premises or handle Redwood data. If subcontractors will act as additional insureds under your policy, that should be noted per-subcontractor. If not, confirm that you will require them to carry equivalent coverage.

Once we have the signed broker attestation with contact info and the subcontractor roster, procurement will confirm conditional PO activation and target release for billing after endorsement receipt.

Thanks — looping in Marissa from Finance to prep the PO.

Irene
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Irene — attaching the subcontractor roster and a formal request PDF our broker will send to the carrier. The broker has added their phone and email to the attestation and confirmed the carrier will prioritize the endorsement request; they estimate 14 business days.

Attached: Subcontractor_List_0429.csv, BlueWave_Endorsement_Request.pdf

Subcontractor highlights: 
- AxisTech Solutions — systems integration; will not store Redwood customer data locally; will have limited access via API keys.
- Meridian Cloud Services — managed infra provider; may handle logs; currently listed for additional insured request.
- LocalEdge Installations — on-site installers for hardware; no data access.

We have documented which subcontractors need to be AI (Meridian) and which will be contractually required to carry equivalent limits (AxisTech, LocalEdge). If Redwood requires AI for AxisTech, we can push the carrier but that may extend timelines.

Please confirm acceptance of the broker-signed attestation (attached earlier) as sufficient to move forward with the conditional PO, and confirm whether Redwood requires Meridian to be named AI prior to PO release.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Legal Ops, BlueWave Analytics
